Deposits, withdrawals and approved rebalances are
real Arc Testnet transactions. Swaps route through
Synthra and are sized from live custody balances.
The chain guard rejects any chainId other than
5042002 before every read and every broadcast.

signing call and is never persisted in plaintext.
